_comment: Build manifest for scripts/build_save.py. lua[] and xml[] are concatenated in THIS ORDER into the TTS save. Order matters: with one shared global namespace and no require(), load order IS the dependency graph — a file that DEFINES something used at load time must precede its consumers. EVERY file under lua/ and xml/ must appear in its list (or in lua_extra/xml_extra); build_save.py hard-fails on an unlisted file and tests/test_lua_statics.py enforces the same rule statically.
_extra_comment: Deliberate exclusions: files that exist but must NOT be concatenated into the bundle. Appended last, order not guaranteed — so anything here must be self-contained AND have no load-time consumers. Prefer adding to lua[]/xml[] at the right position; use this only with a reason stated in the pull request.
